text:
Asha Gupta: Quick help needed — final interview scheduling for candidate André Moreau (Paris, CET). They asked for remote interview window 09:00–11:30 CET only due to childcare. Plan is: 60m system design + 60m coding + 30m hiring manager wrap. Need: panel availability, loaner laptop shipping, live captions, and a calendar invite that includes transcript option.
Marta V: I can cover the system design slot. Wed or Thu next week both ok for me 09:00–11:00 CET.
Tom Rivera: Coding interviewer — I can do Wed 10:00–11:30 CET but only until 11:30. Thu I’m free 09:00–12:00 CET.
Kevin Liu: Ops check — we have a MacBook Air loaner in EU pool. Shipping to FR requires customs form for >€500 equipment — do we want insured courier? ETA 48–72h from pickup.
Sophia Lee: People-ops: we can enable live captions on the Zoom account and ensure auto-transcript afterwards. We’ll also add expense instructions and reimbursement link. Please confirm accommodation details.
Asha Gupta: Confirming: pronouns he/him, needs captions (mild hearing impairment), shipping address: André Moreau, 12 Rue des Rosiers, 75004 Paris, FR. Prefer courier insured. Candidate available Wed 09:00–11:30 CET or Thu 09:00–11:30 CET.
Kevin Liu: OK — I’ll reserve the loaner and queue insured courier for Monday pickup if we finalize today. Need copy of candidate ID name (for label) and LOA signature from hiring team for hardware. Can someone produce LOA text?
Marta V: I’ll draft LOA. Quick question: do we want the coding exercise to be a shared Google Doc or a live coding session in CoderPad?
Tom Rivera: Live CoderPad preferred, 60 minutes. If candidate prefers Google Doc we can adapt.
Sara Ng: I’m on the hiring panel and can do Wed 09:00–10:30 CET (HM wrap or design depending). Add me to the invite.
Asha Gupta: Great — tentative plan: Wed 09:00–10:00 design (Marta), 10:15–11:15 coding (Tom + Sara), 11:15–11:45 HM wrap (Marta). Can everyone please react :thumbsup: to confirm.
recruiter-bot: Draft calendar event created (private): https://calendar.redwood.ai/events/1859001234 — invites not sent until all panelers accept. Include: Zoom with live captions enabled, CoderPad link placeholder, shipping note.
Kevin Liu: I’ll attach shipping tracking to the calendar event once label is printed. Also adding 1-page LOA in the event attachments.
Sophia Lee: I added the reimbursement link and brief accommodation note. Also flagging to security to ensure loaner config is standard image (no elevated creds).
Marta V: LOA sent to Kevin and Asha for signature. Small ask: can we add a 10min buffer between design and coding for quick break?
Tom Rivera: 15min buffer works better — I have to switch windows. 10:15 start for coding is good for me.
Asha Gupta: Updated schedule: design 09:00–10:00, break 10:00–10:15, coding 10:15–11:15, HM 11:15–11:45. I’ll add Sara to invite and send candidate confirmation once courier is booked.
Kevin Liu: Courier booked — DHL express insured. Shipping label attached to event (tracking # DM123456789FR). Loaner ETA Wed 08:30 CET.
Asha Gupta: Sending confirmation to candidate now (message excerpt): "Thanks André — we’ve booked Wed with captions enabled and will ship a loaner. Please reply with the best ID name and phone for courier"
Sara Ng: :thumbsup: all set from my side.
Marta V: Good to go. Thanks team.
recruiter-bot: Reminder set to send candidate check-in 24h before interview.
